title: AMUSEMENT PARK in Australia Where Alex Rides Roller Coasters & Bumper Cars
description:
Amusement Park time in Melbourne Australia part two. The Sandaroo Family is on a family vacation and ride the oldest roller coaster in the entire world at Luna Park. Alex drive in the bumper cars and we see carnival rides and games.
